notes.title: Love Forest Fire? 🔥 Don’t Miss INFEST! (Leaves Early Access Today)
notes.content:
If you were hooked by the chaotic, system-driven gameplay of Forest Fire, then you’re in for a treat with INFEST 1.0! Just like managing fire in Forest Fire, INFEST challenges you to control unpredictable elements like fire, water, oil, and lightning, blending strategy with creative problem-solving.

[previewyoutube=SwAHEu8xwdg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Why Forest Fire Fans Will Love INFEST:[/b]

	•	Elemental Mayhem: INFEST’s environmental interactions—like oil floating on water or lightning electrifying puddles—echo the wild chain reactions of Forest Fire.

	•	Strategic Thinking: Master the chaos with well-planned moves and tactical deckbuilding.

	•	Endless Replayability: INFEST’s procedurally generated levels ensure no two runs are the same, just like Forest Fire’s dynamic scenarios.

INFEST has been in development for over 2 years and leaves Early Access today, don't miss the launch discount before it expires :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/

notes.title: 🔥 INFEST is Here! - New Game from Chute Apps 🔥
notes.content:
Hello Forest Fire players,

We’re thrilled to announce that INFEST, our latest game, has just launched and is now available on Steam!

[previewyoutube=e8zkJGcHRp0;full][/previewyoutube]

Infest is a roguelike deckbuilder where every pixel on the battlefield can burn, freeze, corrode, shock, and melt. Carefully craft your deck and deploy cards to alter the environment, buff your stats, and unleash stunning pixel-by-pixel damage upon your enemies!

If you like Forest Fire we think you'll dig the replayability and style of INFEST. You can wishlist Infest now.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/]Wishlist INFEST On Steam[/url]

Thank you for being part of our gaming community. Your support means the world to us!

The Chute Apps Team

notes.title: Repterra Officially Announced!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=bdESgE-uluo;full][/previewyoutube]

I've been playing RTS games since the early 90s (civ, C&C, OG starcraft). Now we're making our own RTS game, where the goal is to build a colony in a land infest by 100,000 dinosaurs (we let them breed too much, and it got out of control). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768380/Repterra/

I'll also be running a [url=https://chuteapps.com/repterra-beta/]private beta[/url] if you want access to the first playable version.

Stay tuned for more updates :)

notes.title: Major Update V1.1
notes.content:
It's been roughly a month since release and I've got a lot of good feedback during that time.

This update is mostly adjustments based on that feedback, as well as some pretty substantial performance upgrades. The biggest game changer is that the level up thresholds are much lower now and therefore occur more often.

Also.. I've also been working on a demo for my next game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/]Infest[/url]. Give it a wishlist if you haven't already.

I'll be continuing to update Forest Fire with your feedback over the next several months. Many thanks,

-Carl

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Includes a workaround for the Unity bug where the flame won't light on certain PCs (usually laptops with integrated GPUs).

notes.title: V1.0 Release! Forest Fire is out of Early Access.
notes.content:
After many months of hard work, I’m super proud to announce that Forest Fire is out of Early Access!

Thanks to everyone who helped improve the game, it has come a long way and it's a direct result of your feedback :)

I'm also offering a launch discount for everyone who hasn't checked it out yet, so grab your copy while it lasts!

As you probably know I've got lots of other projects in the pipeline, so stay tuned for more updates to Forest Fire, as well as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307840/Sandbox_Skyline/]Sandbox Skyline[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/]Infest[/url].

Thanks for you support along the way! As always you can [url=https://chuteapps.com/discord]reach me on discord [/url]if you have any feedback or questions. 

-Carl

notes.title: ENDLESS MODE
notes.content:
A map that never ends, and clouds that never die. ENDLESS mode is the latest challenge in Forest Fire V0.9

Get as far as you can and earn a 3 Star Rating. All five levels are playable in this new mode.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2242220/extras/gif2-optimized.gif[/img]

We are getting close to leaving early access! More announcements about the full release coming soon :)

-Carl

notes.title: March Update - Endless Mode and INFEST
notes.content:
ENDLESS MODE levels 1 and 2 are now playable in V0.8.2!

The full set of levels is still on track to be ready by Apr 10th :)

ALSO I've announced my next project: INFEST

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/

It's a roguelite deckbuilder where every pixel is physically simulated. If you like Forest Fire I'm sure you'll love Infest![url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/] Give it a wishlist![/url]

We're getting close to Forest Fire full release and I'm really happy with how the game has developed. Thanks again for your support!

-Carl

notes.title: INSANE MODE!
notes.content:
If you're a glutton for punishment, INSANE mode is now ready for you in V0.8!

Unlock it by completing the main quest.

Here's a few other things that have changed since V0.7:

Updated level-up system
Updated graphics
More experience point unlockable atrributes (for a total of 10)
New items UI (Under the Info menu)
Other tweaks and performance fixes

Thanks again for your feedback and help shaping the game! If you haven't already, don't forget to leave me a short review on Steam.

Coming up Next in V0.9: Endless Mode.

-Carl

notes.title: New Languages: Spanish, Russian, and Chinese!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Spanish, Russian, and Chinese versions of Forest Fire have been verified and are now in game. The languages have all been manually checked, however if something isn't 100% right, please reach out in our [url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord]Discord[/url] :)

Carl

notes.title: Japanese 日本 Language now available!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Forest Fire is now playable in Japanese!

To adjust the language you can go to Settings -> Game Settings. 

The translations have been manually verified however if you find something that still isn't 100% right please let me know on [url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord]Discord.[/url]

Thank you and I'm glad we are able to reach our friends in Japan.

-Carl

notes.title: Release Date! (May 10th) and Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
THE PLAN:

notes.title: V0.5.0 Major Update
notes.content:
It's been a great first week of early access and I've gotten so much insightful feedback from you the players! Here's what's changed in the game since V0.4 (initial EA release):

-Tiny explosive villages
-New Powerup: FlameWeed
-New Powerup: FlameRing
-New Powerup: Ember Tosser
-New Powerup: Oil Dropper
-New Powerup: Explosion Multiplier
-New Powerup: Explosive Humans
-New Explosion Combo system
-Balanced pickup attractor powerup
-Level up icons now in Win/Fail UIs
-Added Dpad support for contoller
-Improved UI tips
-Fire trucks now attack you
-Added ‘full’ indicators to inferno and health powerups
-Added level tree goal indicator
-Added more descriptions to items
-Improved level win sequences
-New animated storm cloud faces
-Can now allocate a max of 50 to each persistent powerup
-New Inferno Duration and Inferno points multiplier for experience
-Many other balances and fixes

We're continuing to add more for the next release. If you have any feedback let me know via discord:
http://www.chuteapps.com/discord

Thanks for the great response so far and I'm looking forward to making Forest Fire even better!

-Carl

notes.title: Forest Fire is now available!
notes.content:
The day has come...Forest Fire is now ready to play in all its combustive glory!

This is the beginning of our Early Access journey, and are super excited to see how the game evolves over the next few months.

I truly appreciate your feedback and will use it to make the game better. Open a thread on the Steam discussions or[url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord] join our discord to connect![/url] 

This has been a labor of love and I hope you enjoy this unique little game!

-Carl

notes.title: Forest Fire will be released on Early Access Jan 11!
notes.content:
It's almost time to burn! 

We're getting Forest Fire ready to unleash it's destruction upon Early Access. We're super excited to be sharing months of work with you and to see what kind of changes and upgrades we make during early access. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2242220/extras/oilsquare-optimized.gif[/img]

January 11th the world will burn :)

-Carl

notes.title: December Update - Release date set!
notes.content:
Hell Everyone,

I'm super excited to announce that Forest Fire will be released on Early Access in January 2023! 

We have made a lot of progress over the last several months, some of the things we've added recently:

-5 playable flame characters with different abilities
-More humans
-More explosions
-More secrets / unlockables
-Achievements
-Landmarks buildings (White House, Statue of Liberty... I won't spoil the rest)

And much more to come! If you haven't already, wishlist Forest Fire to stay up to date. Looking forward to having the game live in Jan 2023!

-Carl
